question: A man bought mangoes at the rate of 12 for Rs. 900 and sold them at the rate of 9 for Rs. 1,200. His profit percentage in the transaction is:
solution:
**Given:**

Cost price (CP) of 12 mangoes = ₹900

Selling price (SP) of 9 mangoes = ₹1,200

**Formula used:**

Cost price of 1 mango = Total cost price / Number of mangoes

Selling price of 1 mango = Total selling price / Number of mangoes

Profit % = ((SP - CP) / CP) × 100

**Calculation:**

Cost price of 1 mango:

⇒ CP of 1 mango = 900 / 12 = ₹75

Selling price of 1 mango:

⇒ SP of 1 mango = 1200 / 9 = ₹133.33

Profit percentage:

⇒ Profit % = ((133.33 - 75) / 75) × 100

⇒ Profit % = (58.33 / 75) × 100

⇒ Profit % = 77.78% ≈ 77(7)/(9)\%

**∴ The correct answer is 77(7)/(9)\%**.
